rules.statement: The provisions of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance (particularly Section 2 and related sections) are intended to prevent frauds and perjuries, as stated in its preamble, and should not be invoked to conceal the truth or defeat justice.
rules.supporting_quote: The provisions of the said Prevention of Frauds Ordinance (particularly Section 2 and related sections) are intended to prevent frauds and perjuries, as stated in its preamble, and should not be invoked to conceal the truth or defeat justice.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance
